item.title: Court says the IRS can continue to share immigrants' taxpayer data with ICE
item.description: A federal court on Tuesday rejected a request from an immigrant rights group to temporarily block the IRS from sharing certain taxpayer data.

item.title: ABC7 News producer stranded in Puerto Vallarta details city's recovery following El Mencho's death
item.description: Eating at beachside restaurants, frolicking in hotel pools. The mayhem in Mexico appears to be subsiding in the tourist destination of Puerto Vallarta. ABC7 News producer Juan Carlos Guerrero - who got stranded there on vacation - ventured out to see the recovery firsthand.

item.title: Man, woman found shot to death at San Jose shopping center parking lot, police say
item.description: Two people were found dead following a shooting in a San Jose parking lot on Tuesday, according to San Jose police.

item.title: VIDEO: Sonoma County home on the verge of collapse amid landslide threat
item.description: The owners of a home in Guerneville have been told to get out as their house has been red tagged after water damaged an erosion control barrier. Ahead of Tuesday's storm, officials told neighbors to be prepared to evacuate if conditions get worse.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Rain spreads tonight; spotty showers linger into early tomorrow morning
item.description: The Level 1 system has been bringing rain to the North Bay. It will start to spread to other areas tonight. Expect breezy to gusty conditions near the coast and over the hills. Spotty showers will linger into early tomorrow morning.

item.title: UC Berkeley student gets $25,000 scholarship from Chick-fil-A CEO
item.description: UC Berkeley student Danna Avila from San Jose got a special surprise from Chick-fil-A CEO at the Chick-fil-A in Emeryville Tuesday.

item.title: Tracking fisherman to track fish: The new technological approach to better understand ocean life
item.description: There's a lot of fish in the sea, but there may be even more fisherman. Now scientists are trying something different: they are tracking the anglers in order to track the fish. The hope is that they can better understand when, where, and maybe why marine life is moving around under the sea.

item.title: Takeaways from Trump's State of the Union address: Sales mode on economy, heavy on patriotism
item.description: President Trump used his State of the Union address to sell a booming America, even as voters worry about the economy.

item.title: Santa Clara County to stop using Flock Safety cameras in several cities after privacy concerns
item.description: The vote comes after news broke that the camera network was being used by the federal government against the wishes of many cities and counties.

item.title: More than 200 SF court clerks could go on strike over alleged unfair labor practices on Thursday
item.description: San Francisco clerks at the Superior Court are prepared to walk off the job starting Thursday. They're threatening to strike over alleged unfair labor practices.
